answers.core: NavigationServer is as core as can be and while I can imagine an add-on that reimplements rollback-aware navigation, that would defeat the purpose of having a NavigationServer in the first place and I imagine it would be *way* less performant.
answers.workaround:
Only workarounds I can think of are:
- Forgoing built-in navigation and implementing your own, which I'm quite sure can't be done in a few lines
- GDExtension or rolling out my own version of the engine (which is what I'm currently doing, but of course this is not a very good long term solution and it only helps me)

title: Add ability to roll back and manually step navigation state
